alerts.headline: Dense Fog Advisory issued November 5 at 9:48AM PST until November 5 at 10:00AM PST by NWS Hanford CA
alerts.description:
Low visibility (Tule Fog) continues to lift this morning with patches
of fog still making driving conditions hazardous. Overall,
improvement in visibility allowed threat to end this morning.
